title: Key generation CLI writes the private key to disk and registers only the public key
intent: Distilled from SSH/deploy-key generators: the CLI destructures publicKey and privateKey from crypto.generateKeyPairSync, writes the private key to a 0600 file, logs its length, and posts only the public key to a registration endpoint over https.request. code.key-material-exfiltration must keep the destructured public key untainted and must not treat a file write or a length read as egress. The script is unchanged in this patch, so the release rolls up low.
